# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cli_reference.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

This page is the `--help` output of every `tau2` command, generated from the
CLI. Regenerate it after changing any option:

```bash
uv run --frozen python scripts/generate_cli_reference.py
```

For how the commands fit together, see
[Running the benchmark](running-the-benchmark.md) and the
[submission guide](leaderboard-submission.md). Terms are defined in the
[glossary](glossary.md). `tau2 intro` prints a short overview in the terminal.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`tau2 judges`](#tau2-judges) | Saved-run diagnostic judging and reports |
| [`tau2 tasks`](#tau2-tasks) | Frozen canonical task subsets |
| [`tau2 factory`](#tau2-factory) | Staged language authoring and publication |
| [`tau2 benchmarks`](#tau2-benchmarks) | Released benchmark manifests and their pins |
| [`tau2 run`](#tau2-run) | Run a benchmark |
| [`tau2 run-pass3`](#tau2-run-pass3) | Run Pass^3 on three ordinary or crossed trials |
| [`tau2 languages`](#tau2-languages) | Inspect and validate published language packs |
| [`tau2 intake-tasks`](#tau2-intake-tasks) | Generate and verify τ-Entity tasks |
| [`tau2 play`](#tau2-play) | Play manual mode - interact with a domain as the agent |
| [`tau2 view`](#tau2-view) | View simulation results |
| [`tau2 domain`](#tau2-domain) | Show domain documentation |
| [`tau2 start`](#tau2-start) | Start all servers |
| [`tau2 worker`](#tau2-worker) | Run a worker process that executes simulations for a tau2 controller (see `tau2 run --workers`). |
| [`tau2 intro`](#tau2-intro) | Show an overview of tau-bench and available commands |
| [`tau2 check-data`](#tau2-check-data) | Check if data directory is properly configured |
| [`tau2 evaluate-trajs`](#tau2-evaluate-trajs) | Evaluate trajectories and update rewards |
| [`tau2 review`](#tau2-review) | Run LLM-based conversation review on simulation results |
| [`tau2 leaderboard`](#tau2-leaderboard) | Show the tau-bench leaderboard |
| [`tau2 submit`](#tau2-submit) | Leaderboard submissions |
| [`tau2 convert-results`](#tau2-convert-results) | Convert simulation results between storage formats |

## `tau2 judges`

```text
usage: tau2 judges [-h] {suite,summarize,export,candidate,validate,promote} ...

positional arguments:
  {suite,summarize,export,candidate,validate,promote}
    suite               Plan or resume selected judges on a saved run
    summarize           Read saved diagnostic scores and coverage without model calls
    export              Export typed saved diagnostics and provenance without model
                        calls
    candidate           Run an unvalidated candidate in a separate output directory
    validate            Validate held-out evidence
    promote             Export a reviewed validated registry bundle

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

### `tau2 judges suite`

```text
usage: tau2 judges suite [-h] [--only ONLY] [--trials TRIALS [TRIALS ...]]
                         [--processes PROCESSES] [--concurrency CONCURRENCY]
                         [--unit-retries UNIT_RETRIES] [--preserve-errors] [--force]
                         [--dry-run] [--registry REGISTRY] [--json] [--output OUTPUT]
                         results

positional arguments:
  results               Ordinary Results JSON, run directory, or benchmark matrix root

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --only ONLY           Comma-separated measure names; default all selected measures
  --trials TRIALS [TRIALS ...]
                        Explicit stored trial indices; default all trials
  --processes PROCESSES
                        Independent judge workers; default 1
  --concurrency CONCURRENCY
                        Judge calls in flight per worker; default 1
  --unit-retries UNIT_RETRIES
                        Further attempts at units whose judge reply was incomplete or
                        invalid, in the same run; default 2
  --preserve-errors     Keep recorded judge errors/partials while filling missing
                        verdicts
  --force               Recompute matching verdicts
  --dry-run             Plan without model calls or progress writes
  --registry REGISTRY   Explicit verified promotion bundle; never an unvalidated
                        candidate
  --json                Print the full typed export (plan, summary, verdicts) as JSON
                        instead of the compact table
  --output OUTPUT       Also write the full typed export as JSON to this file
```

## `tau2 factory`

```text
usage: tau2 factory [-h]
                    {autoform,inventory-database,refresh-regional-bundle,init-request,draft,validate,review-content,approve,stage-pack,add-domain,prepare-voices,reuse-voices,audition,validate-voices,record-created-voice,finalize,draft-judge,compile-judge,register-judge,list-judges,draft-database-localization,revise-database-localization,compile-approved-regional,publish-pack-extension,export-localization-spreadsheet,ingest-localization-spreadsheet,export-localization-entities-csv}
                    ...

positional arguments:
  {autoform,inventory-database,refresh-regional-bundle,init-request,draft,validate,review-content,approve,stage-pack,add-domain,prepare-voices,reuse-voices,audition,validate-voices,record-created-voice,finalize,draft-judge,compile-judge,register-judge,list-judges,draft-database-localization,revise-database-localization,compile-approved-regional,publish-pack-extension,export-localization-spreadsheet,ingest-localization-spreadsheet,export-localization-entities-csv}
    autoform            Draft a validated author form for local review
    inventory-database  Inventory canonical databases and frozen tasks as a
                        localization source
    refresh-regional-bundle
                        Rebind an installed regional map to this checkout's source
                        content and republish a byte-identical runtime bundle
    init-request        Write a valid draft-request.json skeleton (frozen-50 tasks,
                        caller genders, inventories) for a new language; offline
    draft               Build localized entities and draft language content for one
                        content review
    validate            Validate staged content and print its review digest
    review-content      Render staged language, entity and task content for human
                        review
    approve             Record a reviewer's approval of the exact digest they
                        inspected
    stage-pack          Stage an existing runtime pack for a new domain revision
    add-domain          Bind another reviewed supported domain to a staged language
    prepare-voices      Provision voices and store resumable audition evidence
    reuse-voices        Reuse reviewed voices after a domain-only revision
    audition            Export exact native-text voice previews for listening review
    validate-voices     Validate audio and provenance; optionally check voice access
    record-created-voice
                        Record an account voice after an uncertain creation
    finalize            Publish an immutable reviewed runtime language bundle
    draft-judge         Author independent agent criteria
    compile-judge       Compile reviewed criteria into an UNVALIDATED candidate
    register-judge      Publish a reviewed reusable authoring entry; never enable
                        production
    list-judges         List authoring ideas, validated sources and reusable reviewed
                        entries
    draft-database-localization
                        Draft native/romanized regional maps through fixed prompts
    revise-database-localization
                        Redraft selected fields while retaining verified regional
                        mappings
    compile-approved-regional
                        Compile a digest-approved regional map for a separate-run
                        extension
    publish-pack-extension
                        Bind approved regional bundles for separate runs only
    export-localization-spreadsheet
                        Export map-backed entity review with one tab per language
    ingest-localization-spreadsheet
                        Validate workbook decisions and export map review evidence
    export-localization-entities-csv
                        Export classified entity pairs without scripts or protocol
                        JSON

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```


### `tau2 benchmarks pin`

```text
usage: tau2 benchmarks pin [-h] [--revision REVISION] [--from SOURCE]
                           [--mode {text,voice}]
                           [--benchmark-version BENCHMARK_VERSION]
                           name

positional arguments:
  name                  Benchmark manifest name, e.g. voice or text

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --revision REVISION   New manifest revision label; required when any pin changes
  --from SOURCE         Derive a new manifest from this one's cells
  --mode {text,voice}   Call mode with --from
  --benchmark-version BENCHMARK_VERSION
                        Benchmark generation with --from
```

## `tau2 run`

```text
usage: tau2 run [-h] [--communicate-scorer {semantic,substring}]
                [--communicate-judge JSON] [--no-localize-db] [--language LANGUAGE]
                [--benchmark BENCHMARK] [--dry-run] [--json]
                [--global-limit GLOBAL_LIMIT] [--voice VOICE]
                [--domain {mock,airline,retail,telecom,telecom-workflow,banking_knowledge,intake}]
                [--num-trials NUM_TRIALS]
                [--agent {llm_agent,llm_agent_gt,llm_agent_solo,discrete_time_audio_native_agent}]
                [--agent-llm AGENT_LLM] [--agent-llm-args AGENT_LLM_ARGS]
                [--user {user_simulator,dummy_user,voice_streaming_user_simulator}]
                [--user-llm USER_LLM] [--user-llm-args USER_LLM_ARGS]
                [--task-set-name {mock,airline,retail,telecom_full,telecom_small,telecom,telecom-workflow,banking_knowledge,intake}]
                [--task-split-name TASK_SPLIT_NAME]
                [--task-ids TASK_IDS [TASK_IDS ...]] [--num-tasks NUM_TASKS]
                [--max-steps MAX_STEPS] [--max-errors MAX_ERRORS] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                [--save-to SAVE_TO] [--max-concurrency MAX_CONCURRENCY]
                [--workers WORKERS] [--provider-limit PROVIDER_LIMIT] [--seed SEED]
                [--log-level LOG_LEVEL] [--verbose-logs] [--audio-debug]
                [--audio-taps] [--llm-log-mode {all,latest}]
                [--max-retries MAX_RETRIES] [--retry-delay RETRY_DELAY]
                [--enforce-communication-protocol] [--user-persona USER_PERSONA]
                [--audio-native]
                [--audio-native-provider {openai,openai_live,gemini,xai,nova,qwen,avartha_pipecat,phonic,livekit,launa}]
                [--cascaded-config CASCADED_CONFIG]
                [--audio-native-model AUDIO_NATIVE_MODEL]
                [--avartha-base-url AVARTHA_BASE_URL] [--live-config LIVE_CONFIG]
                [--realtime-generation | --no-realtime-generation]
                [--reasoning-effort {minimal,low,medium,high,xhigh}]
                [--tick-duration TICK_DURATION]
                [--max-steps-seconds MAX_STEPS_SECONDS]
                [--speech-complexity {control,regular,control_audio,control_accents,control_behavior,control_audio_accents,control_audio_behavior,control_accents_behavior}]
                [--channel-effects-mode {light,regular,heavy}]
                [--speech-effects-mode {light,regular,heavy}]
                [--pcm-sample-rate PCM_SAMPLE_RATE] [--telephony-rate TELEPHONY_RATE]
                [--wait-to-respond-other WAIT_TO_RESPOND_OTHER]
                [--wait-to-respond-self WAIT_TO_RESPOND_SELF]
                [--yield-when-interrupted YIELD_WHEN_INTERRUPTED]
                [--yield-when-interrupting YIELD_WHEN_INTERRUPTING]
                [--interruption-check-interval INTERRUPTION_CHECK_INTERVAL]
                [--integration-duration INTEGRATION_DURATION]
                [--silence-annotation-threshold SILENCE_ANNOTATION_THRESHOLD]
                [--xml-prompt | --no-xml-prompt]
                [--elicitation-strategy {agent_directed,scaffolded}]
                [--complication-rate COMPLICATION_RATE]
                [--retrieval-config {alltools,alltools-qwen,bm25,bm25_grep,bm25_reranker,bm25_reranker_grep,full_kb,golden_retrieval,grep_only,no_knowledge,openai_embeddings,openai_embeddings_grep,openai_embeddings_reranker,openai_embeddings_reranker_grep,qwen_embeddings,qwen_embeddings_grep,qwen_embeddings_reranker,qwen_embeddings_reranker_grep,terminal_use,terminal_use_write}]
                [--retrieval-config-kwargs RETRIEVAL_CONFIG_KWARGS] [--auto-resume]
                [--auto-review] [--review-mode {full,user}]
                [--review-model REVIEW_MODEL]
                [--hallucination-retries HALLUCINATION_RETRIES]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --communicate-scorer {semantic,substring}
                        Communicate-info scorer: the pinned semantic LLM judge
                        (default) or the original substring matching (custom runs
                        only).
  --communicate-judge JSON
                        Semantic judge overrides, e.g. {"model": "...", "model_args":
                        {...}}.
  --no-localize-db      Keep canonical databases, tasks and policies while speaking
                        the selected language; voice runs require --benchmark none.
  --language LANGUAGE   Language pack (default: English). Repeatable for released
                        voice runs; omit there to run all released languages.
  --benchmark BENCHMARK
                        Released benchmark manifest: voice runs default to 'voice'
                        (τ-i18n, V2); use 'voice-v1' for the English current-
                        leaderboard frame. Text runs are custom single-domain runs
                        unless you select 'text'. Use 'none' for a custom single-
                        domain run.
  --dry-run             Resolve and display the run without provider calls or output
                        writes.
  --json                Released benchmarks: print the full resolved plan (with --dry-
                        run) and the full score summary as JSON instead of compact
                        tables.
  --global-limit GLOBAL_LIMIT
                        Total concurrent calls across the benchmark worker fleet.
  --voice VOICE         OpenAI Realtime agent voice override; the released default is
                        marin.
  --domain {mock,airline,retail,telecom,telecom-workflow,banking_knowledge,intake}, -d {mock,airline,retail,telecom,telecom-workflow,banking_knowledge,intake}
                        Domain filter; repeatable for released voice runs. Omit to run
                        all released voice domains.
  --num-trials NUM_TRIALS
                        The number of times each task is run. Default is 1.
  --agent {llm_agent,llm_agent_gt,llm_agent_solo,discrete_time_audio_native_agent}
                        The agent implementation to use. Default is llm_agent.
  --agent-llm AGENT_LLM
                        The LLM to use for the agent. Default is gpt-4.1-2025-04-14.
  --agent-llm-args AGENT_LLM_ARGS
                        The arguments to pass to the LLM for the agent. Default is
                        '{"temperature": 0.0}'.
  --user {user_simulator,dummy_user,voice_streaming_user_simulator}
                        The user implementation to use. Default is user_simulator.
  --user-llm USER_LLM   The LLM to use for the user. Default is gpt-4.1-2025-04-14;
                        τ-Entity uses gpt-5.5.
  --user-llm-args USER_LLM_ARGS
                        The arguments to pass to the LLM for the user. Default is
                        '{"temperature": 0.0}'; the default τ-Entity caller uses
                        {"temperature": 0.0, "reasoning_effort": "low"}.
  --task-set-name {mock,airline,retail,telecom_full,telecom_small,telecom,telecom-workflow,banking_knowledge,intake}
                        The task set to run the simulation on. If not provided, will
                        load default task set for the domain.
  --task-split-name TASK_SPLIT_NAME
                        The task split to run the simulation on. If not provided, will
                        load 'base' split.
  --task-ids TASK_IDS [TASK_IDS ...]
                        Explicit task IDs. Released voice runs accept canonical IDs
                        from exactly one domain; custom/text runs use ordinary task
                        IDs.
  --num-tasks NUM_TASKS
                        Tasks per domain: released voice runs select from each frozen
                        subset, consistently across languages; custom/text runs use
                        ordinary task selection.
  --max-steps MAX_STEPS
                        The maximum number of steps to run the simulation. Default is
                        200.
  --max-errors MAX_ERRORS
                        The maximum number of tool errors allowed in a row in the
                        simulation. Default is 10.
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Maximum wallclock time in seconds for each simulation. No
                        timeout by default.
  --save-to SAVE_TO, --output SAVE_TO
                        The path to save the simulation results. Will be saved to
                        data/simulations/<save_to>/results.json. If not provided, will
                        save to <timestamp>_<domain>_<agent>_<user>. If the file
                        already exists, it will try to resume the run.
  --max-concurrency MAX_CONCURRENCY
                        The maximum number of concurrent simulations to run. Default
                        is 3. With --workers, this is the number of simulations each
                        worker process holds.
  --workers WORKERS     Number of worker processes to spawn. Omitted or 0 runs custom
                        runs in this process; released benchmarks default to one
                        worker and override 0 to one. N > 0 makes this process a
                        controller that schedules and checkpoints while N worker
                        processes execute (N x --max-concurrency simulations in
                        flight); use when scaling beyond the single-process
                        concurrency ceiling.
  --provider-limit PROVIDER_LIMIT
                        Per-provider concurrency caps in controller mode, e.g.
                        "openai=40,gemini=20". Requires --workers.
  --seed SEED           The seed to use for the simulation. Default is 300.
  --log-level LOG_LEVEL
                        The log level to use for the simulation. Default is ERROR.
  --verbose-logs        Enable verbose logging: saves LLM call logs, audio files, per-
                        task logs, and ticks (for audio-native). Files are saved to
                        the save directory (auto-generated if --save-to not
                        specified).
  --audio-debug         Enable audio debugging for audio-native mode. Saves per-tick
                        audio files and timing analysis report for diagnosing
                        alignment issues. Requires --audio-native.
  --audio-taps          Enable audio tap recording for audio-native mode. Saves WAV
                        files at each pipeline stage (pre-effects, post-noise, post-
                        telephony, final, agent-input) for diagnosing signal property
                        differences. Requires --audio-native.
  --llm-log-mode {all,latest}
                        LLM debug logging mode. Only takes effect when --verbose-logs
                        is enabled. 'all' saves every LLM call (can generate many
                        files), 'latest' keeps only the most recent call of each type
                        (saves space). Default is 'latest'. Ignored if --verbose-logs
                        is not specified.
  --max-retries MAX_RETRIES
                        Maximum number of retries for failed tasks. Default is 3.
  --retry-delay RETRY_DELAY
                        Delay in seconds between retries. Default is 1.0.
  --enforce-communication-protocol
                        Enforce communication protocol rules (e.g., no mixed messages
                        with text and tool calls). Default is False.
  --user-persona USER_PERSONA
                        User persona config as JSON dict. Supports explicit values or
                        weighted probabilities. Examples: '{"verbosity": "minimal"}',
                        '{"verbosity": {"minimal": 0.8, "standard": 0.2}}'. If not
                        provided, uses default behavior (standard verbosity).
  --audio-native        Enable audio-native mode using DiscreteTimeAudioNativeAgent
                        with VoiceStreamingUserSimulator. This enables full-duplex
                        voice simulation using audio native APIs.
  --audio-native-provider {openai,openai_live,gemini,xai,nova,qwen,avartha_pipecat,phonic,livekit,launa}
                        Audio native API provider. Default is 'openai'.
  --cascaded-config CASCADED_CONFIG
                        Cascaded config preset name for livekit provider. Available
                        presets: 'default', 'openai-thinking'. See
                        tau2.data_model.cascaded for details.
  --audio-native-model AUDIO_NATIVE_MODEL
                        Audio native model to use. If not specified, uses the default
                        model for the selected provider. For avartha_pipecat, it is
                        only a label, since --avartha-base-url selects the agent.
  --avartha-base-url AVARTHA_BASE_URL
                        URL of the hosted Avartha agent the avartha_pipecat provider
                        calls, https://<host>/inference/serverless/pipecat/v1/public/<
                        agent_id>. Required for that provider, which also needs the
                        live extra and AVARTHA_API_KEY.
  --live-config LIVE_CONFIG
                        JSON config for openai_live: backend_model (required), voice,
                        and optional frontend_prompt/backend_prompt overrides.
  --realtime-generation, --no-realtime-generation
                        Run user LLM/TTS generation without blocking audio ticks.
                        Defaults to enabled for openai_live and avartha_pipecat and
                        disabled for other providers. Use --no-realtime-generation to
                        disable.
  --reasoning-effort {minimal,low,medium,high,xhigh}
                        Reasoning effort for thinking models. Only applies to
                        providers that support it (e.g. OpenAI).
  --tick-duration TICK_DURATION
                        Tick duration in seconds for audio-native mode. Default is
                        0.2.
  --max-steps-seconds MAX_STEPS_SECONDS
                        Maximum conversation duration in seconds. Default is 1200;
                        τ-Entity uses 240.
  --speech-complexity {control,regular,control_audio,control_accents,control_behavior,control_audio_accents,control_audio_behavior,control_accents_behavior}
                        Speech complexity level for audio effects. Default is
                        'regular'.
  --channel-effects-mode {light,regular,heavy}
                        Caller channel overlay for voice runs; regular keeps existing
                        acoustics.
  --speech-effects-mode {light,regular,heavy}
                        Caller speech-behavior overlay for voice runs; regular keeps
                        existing behavior.
  --pcm-sample-rate PCM_SAMPLE_RATE
                        User simulator PCM synthesis sample rate. Default is 16000.
  --telephony-rate TELEPHONY_RATE
                        API/agent telephony sample rate (OpenAI Realtime API). Default
                        is 8000.
  --wait-to-respond-other WAIT_TO_RESPOND_OTHER
                        Min time since OTHER (agent) spoke before user responds
                        (seconds). Default is 1.0.
  --wait-to-respond-self WAIT_TO_RESPOND_SELF
                        Min time since SELF (user) spoke before responding (seconds).
                        Default is 5.0.
  --yield-when-interrupted YIELD_WHEN_INTERRUPTED
                        How long user keeps speaking when agent interrupts (seconds).
                        Default is 1.0.
  --yield-when-interrupting YIELD_WHEN_INTERRUPTING
                        How long user keeps speaking when user interrupts agent
                        (seconds). Default is 5.0.
  --interruption-check-interval INTERRUPTION_CHECK_INTERVAL
                        Interval for checking interruptions (seconds). Default is 2.0.
  --integration-duration INTEGRATION_DURATION
                        Integration duration for linearization (seconds). Default is
                        0.5.
  --silence-annotation-threshold SILENCE_ANNOTATION_THRESHOLD
                        Silence threshold for adding annotations to conversation
                        history (seconds). Default is 4.0.
  --xml-prompt          Use XML tags in system prompt (overrides auto-detection).
  --no-xml-prompt       Use plain text system prompt without XML tags (overrides auto-
                        detection).
  --retrieval-config {alltools,alltools-qwen,bm25,bm25_grep,bm25_reranker,bm25_reranker_grep,full_kb,golden_retrieval,grep_only,no_knowledge,openai_embeddings,openai_embeddings_grep,openai_embeddings_reranker,openai_embeddings_reranker_grep,qwen_embeddings,qwen_embeddings_grep,qwen_embeddings_reranker,qwen_embeddings_reranker_grep,terminal_use,terminal_use_write}
                        Knowledge retrieval config name (banking_knowledge domain).
                        Offline: no_knowledge, full_kb, golden_retrieval, bm25,
                        bm25_grep, grep_only. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY:
                        openai_embeddings*, alltools. Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY:
                        qwen_embeddings*, alltools-qwen. Requires sandbox-runtime:
                        terminal_use*, alltools, alltools-qwen. Default for
                        banking_knowledge: alltools (BM25 + dense + shell).
  --retrieval-config-kwargs RETRIEVAL_CONFIG_KWARGS
                        Arguments to pass to the retrieval config constructor as JSON
                        (e.g., '{"top_k": 10}').
  --auto-resume         Automatically resume from existing save file without prompting
                        (for non-interactive runs).
  --auto-review         Automatically run LLM conversation review after each
                        simulation.
  --review-mode {full,user}
                        Review mode when --auto-review is enabled: 'full' (agent+user
                        errors, default) or 'user' (user simulator only).
  --review-model REVIEW_MODEL
                        LLM model to use for review calls. Default is claude-opus-4-5.
  --hallucination-retries HALLUCINATION_RETRIES
                        Max retries when a user simulator hallucination is detected
                        (full-duplex only). Set to 0 to disable.

τ-entity (formerly elicitation; intake only):
  --elicitation-strategy {agent_directed,scaffolded}
                        Collection strategy. Default: agent_directed; scaffolded
                        selects the prescribed-protocol ablation.
  --complication-rate COMPLICATION_RATE
                        Complication trigger scaling in [0, 1]; 0 disables
                        complications. Default: 1 for both strategies. Inapplicable
                        kinds retain their no-complication probability.
```

```text
  --no-xml-prompt       Use plain text system prompt without XML tags (overrides auto-
                        detection).
  --retrieval-config {alltools,alltools-qwen,bm25,bm25_grep,bm25_reranker,bm25_reranker_grep,full_kb,golden_retrieval,grep_only,no_knowledge,openai_embeddings,openai_embeddings_grep,openai_embeddings_reranker,openai_embeddings_reranker_grep,qwen_embeddings,qwen_embeddings_grep,qwen_embeddings_reranker,qwen_embeddings_reranker_grep,terminal_use,terminal_use_write}
                        Knowledge retrieval config name (banking_knowledge domain).
                        Offline: no_knowledge, full_kb, golden_retrieval, bm25,
                        bm25_grep, grep_only. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY:
                        openai_embeddings*, alltools. Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY:
                        qwen_embeddings*, alltools-qwen. Requires sandbox-runtime:
                        terminal_use*, alltools, alltools-qwen. Default for
                        banking_knowledge: alltools (BM25 + dense + shell).
  --retrieval-config-kwargs RETRIEVAL_CONFIG_KWARGS
                        Arguments to pass to the retrieval config constructor as JSON
                        (e.g., '{"top_k": 10}').
  --auto-resume         Automatically resume from existing save file without prompting
                        (for non-interactive runs).
  --auto-review         Automatically run LLM conversation review after each
                        simulation.
  --review-mode {full,user}
                        Review mode when --auto-review is enabled: 'full' (agent+user
                        errors, default) or 'user' (user simulator only).
  --review-model REVIEW_MODEL
                        LLM model to use for review calls. Default is claude-opus-4-5.
  --hallucination-retries HALLUCINATION_RETRIES
                        Max retries when a user simulator hallucination is detected
                        (full-duplex only). Set to 0 to disable.
  --pass3-mode {generic,crossed}
                        Generic repeated trials (default), or crossed R/C/S voice
                        conditions.
  --regular-results REGULAR_RESULTS
                        Existing ordinary seed-42 regular results to reuse read-only
                        in crossed mode.

τ-entity (formerly elicitation; intake only):
  --elicitation-strategy {agent_directed,scaffolded}
                        Collection strategy. Default: agent_directed; scaffolded
                        selects the prescribed-protocol ablation.
  --complication-rate COMPLICATION_RATE
                        Complication trigger scaling in [0, 1]; 0 disables
                        complications. Default: 1 for both strategies. Inapplicable
                        kinds retain their no-complication probability.
```

## `tau2 view`

```text
usage: tau2 view [-h] [--dir DIR] [--file FILE] [--only-show-failed]
                 [--only-show-all-failed] [--expanded-ticks]
                 [--max-tool-result-chars MAX_TOOL_RESULT_CHARS] [--full-tool-results]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dir DIR             Directory containing simulation files, or a benchmark matrix
                        root. Defaults to data/simulations.
  --file FILE           Path to a simulation results file, ordinary run directory, or
                        benchmark matrix root
  --only-show-failed    Only show failed tasks.
  --only-show-all-failed
                        Only show tasks that failed in all trials.
  --expanded-ticks      Show expanded tick view instead of consolidated (for full-
                        duplex simulations).
  --max-tool-result-chars MAX_TOOL_RESULT_CHARS
                        Truncate tool results (e.g. retrieved knowledge articles) to
                        this many characters. Default: 500.
  --full-tool-results   Show full tool results without truncation.
```

## `tau2 review`

```text
usage: tau2 review [-h] [-m {full,user}] [-o OUTPUT] [--interruption-enabled]
                   [--show-details] [-c MAX_CONCURRENCY] [--limit LIMIT]
                   [--task-ids TASK_IDS [TASK_IDS ...]] [--log-llm]
                   [--review-model REVIEW_MODEL]
                   path

positional arguments:
  path                  Path to a results.json file or a directory containing
                        results.json files

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -m {full,user}, --mode {full,user}
                        Review mode: 'full' (agent+user, default) or 'user' (user
                        simulator only)
  -o OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT
                        Output path for the reviewed results (only used for single
                        file)
  --interruption-enabled
                        Flag indicating that interruption was enabled for these
                        simulations
  --show-details        Show detailed review results for each simulation
  -c MAX_CONCURRENCY, --max-concurrency MAX_CONCURRENCY
                        Maximum number of concurrent reviews (default: 32)
  --limit LIMIT         Limit review to first N simulations
  --task-ids TASK_IDS [TASK_IDS ...]
                        Only review simulations for these task IDs
  --log-llm             Log LLM request/response for each review call
  --review-model REVIEW_MODEL
                        LLM model to use for review calls. Default is claude-opus-4-5.
```

## `tau2 submit`

```text
usage: tau2 submit [-h] {prepare,validate,verify-trajs,interaction-metrics} ...

positional arguments:
  {prepare,validate,verify-trajs,interaction-metrics}
                        Submit subcommands
    prepare             Prepare a submission for the leaderboard
    validate            Validate an existing submission directory
    verify-trajs        Verify trajectory files
    interaction-metrics
                        Compute voice interaction metrics (latency, responsiveness,
                        interrupts, selectivity) from full-duplex trajectories

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

### `tau2 submit prepare`

```text
usage: tau2 submit prepare [-h] --output OUTPUT [--no-verify] [--voice]
                           [--benchmark BENCHMARK] [--metadata-file METADATA_FILE]
                           [--historical-voice-v2] [--judges-root JUDGES_ROOT]
                           input_paths [input_paths ...]

positional arguments:
  input_paths           Paths to trajectory files, directories, or glob patterns

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
                        Output directory to save the submission and trajectories
  --no-verify           Skip trajectory verification step
  --voice               Force voice submission mode (auto-detected from input data if
                        not specified)
  --benchmark BENCHMARK
                        Verify this published preset; otherwise infer from matrix
                        metadata
  --metadata-file METADATA_FILE
                        2.0 packages: JSON with model_name, model_organization,
                        submitting_organization, submission_date and
                        contact_info.email
  --historical-voice-v2
                        Maintainers only: read the frozen 2026-10-02 Voice V2 release
                        export; --benchmark voice (default), banking or entity selects
                        the frame
  --judges-root JUDGES_ROOT
                        With --historical-voice-v2 (voice frame only): a provider's
                        saved verdict directory (<language>/<simulation-id>.json);
                        repeat for each judge suite
```
